notes.title: Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls version 4.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24679254/49db34906f904f32dcdd249819f6dd453fa7798e.png[/img]

Ok so like five years ago one of you nerds were like, "Ok but achievements don't work if for some asinine reason I wanted to turn off this perfectly good overlay," and I was like, "Well too bad" but five minutes later was like, "Alright sure let me fix it." but actually I forgot and just today I was like, "Hey didn't I fix that?"

So here we are back in the year 2022. I present to you, [b]version 4.3[/b] aka "[i]One line of code five years in the making[/i]".

[b]Version 4.3 - May 28, 2022[/b]
[list][*]Fixed achievements and leaderboards not updating if the overlay was disabled.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Destroy all Monster GIrls version 4.2
notes.content:
No, this is not an April Fool! It's really here! [b]You can now use the tab key when mapping keyboard controls![/b]

(And some other things too)

[b]Version 4.2 - April 1, 2022[/b]
[list][*] Stage timer is now off by default and can be re-activated in the options menu.
[*] Removed ban on 'tab' as a mappable key.
[*] Fixed point in Mt Afrokupa where it was easy to accidentally backtrack and get stuck in a previous point in the stage.[/list]

notes.title: Khimera 4.1
notes.content:
Today some minor updates to a few stages and some big changes to the Pumpkin King to make him a little bit more manageable. If the pumpkin heads are giving you a bit too much trouble, you can now [b]defeat them[/b] for some food mid-fight!

Level design changes are primarily to aide in guiding players towards the goal in some areas where the secret route might have been a bit too obvious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24679254/f02dc6c6e8a6f571a7e80eff7cdc2b45dd82f9ff.png[/img]


[b]Version 4.1 - February 22, 2020[/b]
[list][*]Added a visual indicator for kill planes in stages.[/*][*]The Pumpkin King has seen some revisions:[/*][list][*]The Pumpkin King can no longer turn around while charging his fire attack.[/*][*]False Pumpkins can now be defeated with a combination of the harpy boost and the mermaid anchor. They have 8HP (3 hits).[/*][*]Pumpkins will drop food on defeat, offering a slower, but safer method to fighting the Pumpkin King.[/*][*]Pumpkins hover about 8 pixels lower.[/*][*]Pumpkin fire rate rounded up to 4 seconds between shots.[/*][*]Pumpkins now synchronize their shots and will always fire about half a second apart rather than it being dependant on when the pumpkins spawn.[/*][/list][*]Changed backdrop tiles for Mt Afrokupa.[/*][*]Changed how you access Mt Afrokupa TNT switch. In its previous format, it was too easy to mistake for the correct route, leading to confusion.[/*][*]minor level modifications.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera Version 4.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24679254/6eaafe3103636d0e09c6abd8eae457f2cfba388c.png[/img]

At the request of King Captain, one of the Khimera speedrunners, I've added a no-hit medal that will overwrite the no-death medal if you can complete a stage without getting hit!

Honestly that sounds stupid hard so I'm not going to do it but [i]you can[/i] if you like!

[b]Version 4.0 - October 10, 2019[/b]
[list][*]Added no-hit medal for clearing stages without taking a hit![list][*][b]Does not contribute to 100%![/b][/*][*]Obtained for completing the entire stage from start to finish without taking a hit.[/*][*]Replaces no-death medal on map screen.[/*][*]Cannot be obtained with berserk mode active.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera 3.9.1
notes.content:
It's the 391st Khimera! This update fixes a few bugs and refines the changes introduced in 3.9!

[b]Version 3.9.1 - July 29, 2019[/b]
[list][*]Fixed bug introduced in 3.9 causing dash to let Chelshia phase through enemies.[/*][*]Reduced input buffers from 10 frames to 3.[/*][*]Reversed some level modifications.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera version 3.9
notes.content:
Today we have a slew of QoL updates to Chelshia's movement including an input buffering method so she won't drop inputs as often. Also a new checkpoint in Mechanical Mayhem (something suggested for like a year oops)


[b]Version 3.9 - July 28, 2019[/b]
[list][*]Fixed broken background in race results screen.[/*][*]Fixed objects not properly spawning in the center of breakable objects.[/*][*]Fixed being able to climb up into the quiz room from the previous room's ceiling, softlocking the game.[/*][*]Costume choice in race mode now saves, costume will be automatically equipped every time you enter race mode.[/*][*]Attacking & Jumping now have 10-frame buffers. Pressing a button while Chelshia is currently inactive or otherwise too busy to respond will result in an up to 10 frame grace period where the action can take place once she is free again (instead of just dropping the input).[/*][*][b]Saucy Shot changes:[/b][/*][list][*]Releasing punch no longer resets charge, but instead decrements charge level.[/*][*]15 frame buffer added where the button can be released while immobilized and still have it fire once able.[/*][/list][*]Harpie Boost is no longer interrupted by enemies.[/*][list][*]This does not extend to falling spikes, giant cannonballs or track spikes.[/*][/list][*]Added 3rd checkpoint to Mechanical Mayhem between crusher segment and the rising spikes.[/*][*]Minor level modifications.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Added current stage's collectables to HUD when % counter is on.[/*][*]Fixed collected fairy money sometimes spawning in walls.[/*][list][*](This was what was forcing them to teleport to Chelshia, resulting in phantom 100's being collected).[/*][/list][*]Config will not automatically switch to gamepad on boot if the controls have been reconfigured.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera: Destroy All Monster Girls Version 3.5
notes.content:
Recently Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls appeared at AGDQ2019, run by WR holder Snapcase! You can catch up on the run here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ofwao_TP8wI

As for today's update, it is mostly QoL and bugfixes. Chelshia has a new mechanic where she will attempt to nudge up or down on a wall to clear a ledge, helping alleviate issues with just barely missing a gap with the dash.

As always, let me know what you think!

[b]Version 3.5 - January 12, 2019[/b]
[list][*][b]Recovery from backup; some stuff MIGHT BE A LITTLE BIT WEIRD! (please report any errors you find on steam discussion)[/b][/*][*]Chelshia will now attempt to nudge up or down in order to clear ledges.[/*][*]Fixed getting stuck on pogo when catching a ledge just right.[/*][*]Fixed being able to lock Chelshia's moves by firing saucy shot out of a pogo attack.[/*][*]Fixed bosses appearing see-through on map screen during Ragazza Plains Cutscene.[/*][*]Fixed old level theme (fairy theme) playing after completing the quiz.[/*][*]Made trading quest 'item received effect' easier to see.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera version 3.4
notes.content:
In 3.2 I had overhauled how moves work to fix punching locking up directionals. This allowed you to move in midair while punching and preserve your momentumn, but it also introduced a few cases where specific combinations of interraction and attacking would lock up Chelshia.

I believe I've been able to fix these lock-ups but please do not hesitate to drop in on steam discussion or comment on this post if the issue persists. I apologize for the inconvenience.

[b]Version 3.4 - July 9, 2018[/b]
[list][*]Fixed OoB in final stage.[/*][*]Halved screen shake affect on earth shaker.[/*][*]Fixed being able to jump with earth shaker.[/*][*]Fixed lockup related to springs[/*][*]Fixed lockups related to interrupting attacks with dash and boost (hopefully).[/*][*]Fixed Typo in Mimi's bio.[/*][*]Fixed background flicker in ???.[/*][*]Added additional track for ???.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera version 2.0 is out! Harvest Update Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24679254/9960971bde74708dae6aa50be8a53f34926663ca.png[/img]

After many eons of slow, painful development, the HARVEST EVENT is finally playable! You can access it via the extras menu on the title screen.

In order to access this special epilogue episode, you will need to have a file with [b]every main stage and secret stage completed[/b]. Load that file and you should see a message telling you that the event has been unlocked. At that point it will be avaliable in the extras menu.


[b]Version 2.0 - April 19, 2017[/b]
[list][*]MAYBE fixed the weird boot up error some Windows 10 PCs got (Let me know if it persists).[/*][*]HARPIE WING is now a default ability that you will have from the beginning of the game.[/*][*]Defeating Amelia now unlocks HARPIE BOOST, a powerful jump triggered with [UP]+[JUMP] on the ground.[/*][*]Fixed error where second set of DEMON FIRE dialogue wasn't displaying in the lab.[/*][*]Moved CONTROLS menu from main title menu to OPTIONS.[/*][*]default jump button, enter and space now skip opening cutscene.[/*][*]default jump button now skips death cutscene.[/*][*]retiring from a race now brings you to race start screen instead of root title menu.[/*][*]Fixed springs resetting hitstun status and iframes.[/*][*]fixed not being able to chest-attack through the ice blocks at the first checkpoint in Mt Afrokupa[/*][*]fixed DJ Doroko's soundwaves killing Chelshia after the battle ends.[/*][*]fixed possibility of defeated bosses getting trapped in arena ceiling (only really possible with amelia).[/*][*]Pressing A on a costume now equips the costume instead of giving information on it.[/*][*]Pressing A on weapon/ability will now deactivate it, letting you customize which abilities you want to have active.[/*][*]Costume and weapon info is now just part of pause screen display.[/*][*]Q now unpauses the game (why wasn't this a thing before???)[/*][*]Minor fixes to some dialogue art.[/*][*]trading quest progress icon no longer obstructed by Chelshia's talk icon.[/*][*]Chelshia will look around if you press LEFT or RIGHT while she's peeking out of her chest.[/*][*]Chelshia can no longer cancel her jump velocity by releasing jump key after upwards room transition or springboard; only on jump.[/*][*]Chelshia can now bounce on Misboro (both blue and yellow), deflecting their trajectory.[*]Defeating Kiran will cause her to respawn in four seconds instead of 1.5 (if she were to leave the screen normally).[/*][*]New mechanic: Every five enemies you defeat without taking damage will drop double money. notes.title: Khimera Version 1.5 is out!
notes.content:
Just a few small softlock fixes and some general improvements.

I've been asked about card drops a lot and if you've been following the discussion pages, you'll already know that unfortunately it just isn't possible. I'm sorry for everyone who bought the DLC specifically for card drops and I will understand if you request a steam refund.

As an alternative, I've been releasing small batches of steam codes every so often via the discussion pages. If you follow the instructions on the page, you'll be able to activate the game via code and unlock 3 card drops. Check back periodically for new codes.ːchelWinkː


[list][*]The moving platforms on the pirate captain's final fight now despawn when she is defeated.[/*][*]Asked Chelshia to stop flying away after the pirate captain is defeated. Hopefully she listens![/*][*]Made some false walls in Mt Afrokupa and the Oil Rig more noticable.[/*][*]Ice and snow blocks in Mt Afrokupa fall slower so you don't accidentally punch a whole column with one punch.[/*][*]If a health upgrade misses (couldn't replicate it so I dunno), it will just teleport to Chelshia, avoiding the soft-lock.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Khimera OST up on Bandcamp; Trading Card Update
notes.content:
Joe Aquiare, the composer behind Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls has put high-quality MP3 versions of the OST up on Bandcamp for purchase. A few people have been requesting this, so he made it a thing that you can check out right here:

https://brainfoam.bandcamp.com/album/khimera-destroy-all-monster-girls-soundtrack

I've also gotten a few asks about trading cards and yes, these will absolutely be a thing! I'm finishing up the assets over the weekend and the full trading card/badge system should be up at the earliest, Monday evening.

Thank you friends for continuing to support Khimera with your comments and suggestions over the past few weeks. I will continue to do my best to bring entertaining, quality games to Steam!

notes.title: Version 1.2 Has Been Released
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Increased hitbox size on earth breaker. Now lines up with smoke effect.
[*]Increased vertical size of dash hitbox by 4 pixels on each side (1.5x).
[*]regular and strong punch hitboxes now extend into Chelshia, so you can strike enemies overlapping you (as long as they are in the path of your swing).
[*]You can now reflect the pirate explorer's ice picks to pick him off from a distance.
[*]Pirate Explorer now climbs slower to allow more time between attacks.
[*]Added helpful messages to aid first-time players (for example, when you collect your first fairy).
[*]Updated Menu to take into account future content updates.
[*]Added 'PRESS A' prompt to direct user to ASD/Arrows control scheme.
[*]Added NONE option to dash type so you can play using dash (alt) only.
[*]Fixed blockades spawning over the cake in CAKEBOY.
[*]Fixed blockades spawning too close together or too close to the spawn.
[/list]
